children: In the REGAIN trial, all eight treated patients were alive as of November 11, 2026; median overall survival was not reached after median follow-up of 6.9 months among six evaluable patients. All six had an objective response; results remain interim.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
All 8 patients alive; median survival not reached
Encouraging early survival signal, but the small cohort and limited follow-up prevent a reliable survival estimate.
6/6 evaluable patients had objective responses
The response rate is notable in this small trial, though responses in the three most recently assessed patients remain subject to confirmation.
5 complete responses; 1 partial response
Tumor shrinkage strengthens the early efficacy signal; durability and confirmation on later scans remain unresolved.
Sources deployed in all 8 patients; no unanticipated SAEs
Supports feasibility and the reported safety profile, but one previously reported grade 3 seizure-related SAE occurred.
Up to 20 patients planned; enrollment ongoing
Further enrollment and follow-up are needed to assess durability and build evidence for potential market submission.
Necrosis or suspected necrosis in 4 of 6 patients
Some scans remain ambiguous between necrosis and tumor progression; additional imaging may change recurrence findings.
Context by AI Analyst

This is an early clinical signal from a small, ongoing trial, not confirmatory evidence of efficacy. Longer follow-up, confirmation of responses on subsequent scans, and enrollment toward the planned 20 patients are needed to clarify durability and potential regulatory relevance.
